title: Standing General Order crash reporting
summary: NHTSA ordered specified ADS and Level 2 ADAS crash reports from manufacturers and operators; the reports are not determinations of fault.
takeaway: NHTSA ordered specified ADS and Level 2 ADAS crash reports from manufacturers and operators; the reports are not determinations of fault

title: Third amended Standing General Order
summary: Effective June 16, 2025, NHTSA's third amended crash-reporting order requires covered operators and manufacturers to report serious automated-driving or Level 2 driver-assistance crashes within five days and qualifying less-serious crashes monthly. It differentiates reporting thresholds by automation type, reduces duplicate filings, and requires updates when new information becomes available.

title: AV STEP proposal
summary: Proposed a voluntary ADS safety transparency and evaluation program. NHTSA withdrew this proposal in June 2026; no AV STEP program took effect.
takeaway: Proposed a voluntary ADS safety transparency and evaluation program

title: AV STEP withdrawal
summary: NHTSA formally withdrew the 2025 AV STEP proposed rulemaking.
